hooks.text: 战斗中可直接拆下当前炮塔，再装上其他车辆的炮塔，把历史坦克改成混合机体。
hooks.excerpt: Modify Tank During playthrough, you can freely dismantle turrets from your tank and replace it with the turrets from other vehicles.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 坦克社学生各有独特天赋，战斗中招募进车组就会为车辆增加新能力。
hooks.excerpt: Recruit Crews Each student in the tank club has unique talents. Recruiting them into your crew during battles will grant your vehicle new abilities.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从不断扩充的二战车型中选车，再叠加数十种武器和升级带领本地坦克社取胜。
hooks.excerpt: Select your vehicle from a growing list of historical models, then equip dozens of weapons and upgrades to lead your local tank club to victory! The Choice is Yours A growing selection of WWII tanks awaits, as you decide how to achieve victory on the field of battle.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
